summary_en: Develops an acoustic-optical multimodal fusion module for UUV perception using separate sonar and optical YOLOv5 branches, environmental-degradation estimation, cross-modal feature-map matching, deep sparse-autoencoder fusion, and weighted-box fusion. The study validates the approach using synchronized forward-looking-sonar and RGB data from controlled and sea trials, including cross-domain and cross-device tests under turbidity, illumination variation, material differences, and multipath interference.
publication_note: Genuinely new 28 August 2026 camera-sonar fusion paper. Strongly relevant to the repository's acoustic-optical fusion branch, but the primary contribution is object detection/perception rather than image formation or 3D reconstruction, so candidate status is preferred over unconditional main-library promotion.
